description: Fetches 24-hour ADS-B aggregations: unique aircraft count, busiest airports (ranked by unique flights), top origin countries, airport zone activity breakdown (arriving/departing/taxiing/overflight), regional traffic by UN subregion and continent, ground vs airborne split, and emergency squawk counts (7500/7600/7700). Use when the user asks for the daily briefing, traffic statistics, or aggregated flight data.
